answer: Deposits are visible in sonnet, and lotus reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 48 aliases, and each one needs its own funded onyx account. A farm of 2649 identities would post 2847 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
